failure.name: TypeError
failure.cause: The checkpoint rendering evidence stores zero error counts under runtime.counts and per-phase arrays under runtime.phases.*.details. Later batches store top-level runtime arrays. The frozen evidence itself reports zero errors and remains hash-consistent.

recoveryLimit.authorityRequired: one exceptional third audit-tool recovery limited to normalizing the frozen checkpoint and batch rendering runtime schemas

proposedMinimumCorrection.description: Read zero runtime failures from either the historical runtime.counts shape or the later top-level runtime arrays, without changing any rendering evidence.
